changelog:
Quit-weed 1.0.0 – Major first release with enhanced tracking & craving support.

- Added local memory system for streaks, cravings, goals, and triggers, stored in ~/quit-weed/
- Supports multiple quit modes: quit, reduce, or break; guides users to clarify their target
- Introduced structured craving logging and offers evidence-based craving responses
- Surfaces craving and trigger patterns over time based on user logs
- Daily check-in functionality for mood, sleep, and cravings
- All data remains 100% local; privacy-first design
- Removed old skill card, added extensive in-skill documentation and references
summary: Cannabis cessation tracker and coach. Track sober days, log cravings, identify triggers, manage withdrawal, and get evidence-based craving support.
